base: pure-oreb-turnover-time-1; retain individual OREB allocation; source verifier oreb-zone-reader-1
scope: seen-data diagnosis plus one single-mechanism ablation, not baseline adoption or a calibrated production candidate
sampling: first eligible player FG OREB per possession, same previous full-possession sample and exclusions; ordinary FT included; raw zone repaired with frozen reader

observableGroups.early: first FG/ordinary FT/ownership loss <=3 seconds after rebound
observableGroups.later: first decisive event >3 seconds; landmark survivors not assigned putback intent
observableGroups.quickProxy: first own FG, same rebounder, repaired short zone, <=3 sec; ex-post outcome, never denominator for loss hazard
observableGroups.foul: any defensive nonshooting foul before first decisive event, report <=3sec separately; first decisive event does not close at ordinary nonshooting foul
observableGroups.window: 3-second risks exclude every anchor with <3 seconds remaining in period, regardless of observed outcome; keep full sample for points and quickProxy

latent: simulation first durationObserver after anchor marks putback vs restart; real intent unobserved, so no real mode-specific failure rates claimed

ablation.name: skipGenericPutbackTouchRisk
ablation.on: keep and consume same touch turnover RNG draw but ignore generic pTovTouch failure only when putback!==null; pass, foul, shot-clock, cards, timing and rebound logic unchanged
ablation.off: exact baseline scores/teams and fullOreb projection parity
ablation.interpretation: zeroing a nonidentified generic risk gives mechanism sensitivity only; not evidence of zero real putback losses; cannot promote from these 3-seed results

metrics: early loss and late loss before first attempt
early nonshooting defensive foul before attempt
conditional shot make/zone distribution, interpreted as selection
latent sim mode counts and losses
3seed descriptive net/wins error; no adoption claim
interval: 20000 franchise+seed paired across seasons, equal-season ratios; 95% descriptive only
stop: report facts/inference/failures and stop; no further mechanism or calibration
